findings.claim: The focused composer now draws a focus outline even though the acceptance criteria require no focused outline/ring.
findings.evidence: The hunk adds `has-[:focus-visible]:outline-2 has-[:focus-visible]:outline-offset-2 has-[:focus-visible]:outline-ring` to `ComposerPrimitive.AttachmentDropzone`, while acceptance criterion 3.2 says the composer test covers `no border or outline when focused` and `specs/chat-surfaces/spec.md` says focused composer has `no ember or ring outline`.
findings.suggested_fix: Either remove the focus outline and satisfy the current criterion, or update the OpenSpec/design acceptance criteria to require the new focus outline before marking this change complete.

findings.claim: A2UI status pills are placed in a `role="status"` live region, contradicting the design spec's explicit ban on live status roles inside streamed blocks.
findings.evidence: The A2UI status row adds `<div role="status" aria-live="polite" className="contents">`, but `docs/design/chat-surfaces.md` §5 says: `Do not put role="status" on pills inside streamed blocks. The message log is already a polite live region, and a live role on every pill would announce each state change mid-stream.`
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `role="status"`/`aria-live` from streamed block pills, or revise the design spec and acceptance evidence to explicitly allow this A2UI exception.

findings.claim: Failed tool results render the raw `result` string directly instead of mapping it to plain-language error copy.
findings.evidence: In the failed branch, the component renders `{result}` inside the danger block; `docs/design/chat-surfaces.md` §7.3 requires `failed with a message: ... plain language`, and §3.8 similarly rejects raw runtime/transport errors in user-facing message surfaces.
findings.suggested_fix: Map failed tool results to controlled user-facing copy, or sanitize/classify known tool error payloads before rendering.
